title: Model Audit Finding
description: One audit finding (F number). Extends the MVP shared-issue schema; severity follows the Roadmap (Blocker / Major / Minor) and 'cannot judge' is a status, not a severity. Mapping to shared-issue: blocker = Blocker; warning = Major or Minor (judged); info is not a finding (see L1-Domain/DK-AUD-005 section 4).

task.description: Main task the finding belongs to.

title.description: One-line statement of the problem, in plain English.

clause.description: BIMGBPS clause plus LIM-nn / APL-nn where relevant.

element_id.description: Model element / view / sheet ID. Never shown in the AP report.

value.description: Value with unit, three decimals for areas.

note.description: What the evidence shows. Must not contain element IDs (they are redacted in the AP report).

evidence_id.description: ID of an item in audit-results evidence[] (screenshot, crop, swatch, csv).

overturn_if.description: What fact would change the conclusion.

gap.description: L4 capability gap, if the finding depends on one.
